messages:
Maria G: Heads-up — rolling out the Change Visibility panel in the console tomorrow. It will show a compact diff for runtime config changes + an 'ops kit' (pause/rollback, runbook links). Quick sanity check before we ship?

Akshay P: +1 on ops kit. Question: will we display full JSON diffs in the UI? That could leak secrets and will probably blow up our audit/telemetry volume.

Jordan L: My vote is compact diffs by default (keys changed, values redacted). Provide a gated 'show full diff' flow that records who viewed it.

Sam O: Implementation note — don't route full diffs through the main telemetry stream. Stream them from change-service and store only short metadata in the event ledger.

Akshay P: API semantics debate: expose GET /changes/:id?include=full (param) or a separate endpoint like POST /changes/:id/preview that returns ephemeral content? The param is simpler for callers but harder to audit and RBAC.

Jordan L: Prefer separate endpoint POST /changes/:id/preview -> returns short-lived token and creates an audit entry. Easier to rate-limit and distinguish full-diff access in logs.

Maria G: UX idea: inline compact preview in the console (human-readable key list) with a "View full diff" button that hits the preview endpoint. Ops kit should show: pause rollout, tag freeze, quick rollback, and a link to the runbook.

Sam O: For runbook integration, emit runbook_url in change metadata. The ops kit will surface it and allow a quick "open runbook" action plus a button that calls internal rollback:

```
curl -X POST https://internal.api.redwood/change-service/v1/changes/{id}/rollback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"reason":"ops_pause_from_console"}'
```

Akshay P: Telemetry gating: console dashboard should only surface changes if they affect at least one target (host/pool) and pass a safety check. We should track metrics: preview_count, full_diff_views, pause_events, rollback_triggers.

Jordan L: Security note — preview tokens should be single-use and expire fast (10s). Make the preview endpoint require a separate permission scope (changes:preview:view).

Maria G: Also: do not index redacted values in console search. Default redact by key patterns (api_key, secret, token), allow a whitelist for explicit keys.

ops-bot: deploybot: change 1718012345 scheduled for canary at 2025-06-15T16:00:00Z — reminder set.

Maria G: Great. Console team, Sam — can you prototype the compact diff + preview flow today? We'll demo at the eng-platform sync tomorrow.
